name: @types/titanium
description: The stub the classic fixture carries, pointed at rather than copied: `types` is a path joined to the package directory, so this resolves to the one copy. The stub encodes edge cases of the real package — `add: never` among them — that two copies would drift on. alloy-project deliberately has no types at all, because several tests use it to cover what happens when none resolve, so this fixture exists to be the Alloy project that does.
